name: iridescent-ribbon
title: Iridescent Ribbon
description: A procedural iridescent light ribbon in one WebGL 2 shader: a travelling wave of red, green and blue bands that spreads into a soft color field.
author: Mark By <https://github.com/mark-x64>
docs:
Installed `IridescentRibbon` in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/`. Render `<IridescentRibbon className="rounded-lg" />`: a 16:9 stage whose background is `--iridescent-ribbon-background` (black).

Use `sequence="wave"` for a calm loop, `playing={false}` to pause, or `time={1.43}` for a still. The shader is analytic (no textures); rendering pauses off screen and in hidden tabs, and a static picture replaces it without WebGL 2 or under reduced motion.

Ported from mark-x64's ribbon shader study (MIT, copyright 2026 Mark By), renamed and without its reference footage; the license text is in the file.
